summary: The framework authenticates subscribers with TV providers and feeds subscription state to the Apple TV app. It depends on Apple's streaming service and TV provider accounts, which BifrOSt does not have. BifrOSt has no SDK API for TV provider sign-in or subscription lookup.

features.note: Needs a TV provider's SAML authentication service; there is no provider integration in BifrOSt.
Feeds subscription state to the Apple TV app, which BifrOSt does not ship.

features.feature: User account management and single sign-on
features.note: BifrOSt Account is for the BifrOSt cloud service, not for signing in to third-party media accounts.
Errors only exist for the provider flows above.
